data.title: Intel Influx Event: Earn More Intel & Get Upgrade Discounts!
data.meta_title: Intel Influx Event: Earn More Intel & Get Upgrade Discounts!
data.content:
Intel is a crucial resource used to upgrade your battle Builds. You can never have enough, so from July 29 until August 26 (10:00 CEST/01:00 PT), we’re making it easier than ever to earn Intel and maximize your Builds’ potential with bonus Intel and upgrade discounts!

Upgrade Discounts (July 29–August 12)

Get your Builds up to scratch. Enjoy Intel upgrade discounts on the following items throughout the Intel Influx Event:

  • War Robot Modules: Siren, Cyclops, Pursuer
  • Weapons: Trident, Railgun, Gemini, Scatter
  • Gear: Energy Wall (Supply Gear), Homing Missile (Cycle Gear), Umbrella (Cycle Gear), Supply Gear: Blink (Supply Gear), Recon Mode (Cycle Gear)

War Robot Modules (Common Upgrades)

  • Level 3: 6 Intel (Previously 20 Intel)
  • Level 5: 12 Intel (Previously 40 Intel)
  • Level 9: 33 Intel (Previously 110 Intel)
  • Level 13: 100 Intel (Previously 230 Intel)

War Robot Modules (Uncommon Upgrades)

  • Level 3: 9 Intel (Previously 30 Intel)
  • Level 5: 18 Intel (Previously 60 Intel)
  • Level 9: 50 Intel (Previously 165 Intel)
  • Level 13: 150 Intel (Previously 345 Intel)

War Robot Modules (Rare Upgrades)

  • Level 3: 12 Intel (Previously 40 Intel)
  • Level 5: 24 Intel (Previously 80 Intel)
  • Level 9: 66 Intel (Previously 220 Intel)
  • Level 13:200 Intel (Previously 460 Intel)

Intel Catch-Up for New Players (July 29–August 26)

If you’re trying to get your Builds battle-ready, we’ve got just the ticket. New players can level up to unlock Intel. Simply hit the following milestones to secure your bonus:

  • Level 2: 30 Intel
  • Level 4, 6, 8, 10 & 12: 15 Intel
  • Level 15: 50 Intel

Intel Catch-Up for Returning Players (July 29–August 26)

Just coming back to the fray and need a boost? Returning players can battle daily for up to seven days to unlock bonus Intel:

  • Day 1: 100 Intel
  • Day 2: 20 Intel
  • Day 3: 20 Intel
  • Day 4: 25 Intel
  • Day 5: 30 Intel
  • Day 6: 40 Intel
  • Day 7: 50 Intel

Earn Intel and upgrade your Builds to the max between now and August 26!

Follow War Robots: Frontiers on X and Facebook, and join the official Discord server to get all the latest intel about the game.

Need help? Contact our Support team to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten.
